    win is  step up  the win is one step above the current position

 Problem:  
   The player is being pushed down and left by the baba rule No matter how many times we move up the rule overrides us We will never reach the win

 Possible solutions:
    Change the rule for baba to make it move upward eg baba is  step up
    Change the win condition eg make win be reachable from current position
    Change what you is eg make you something else
    Break existing rules or reposition text blocks

 Can we move text blocks  
   Yes  all rules are in the form of text blocks eg rule baba  step to the left and  steps down and are not marked as immovable We can reposition them

 Best solution:  
   Move the rule baba is  step to the left and  steps down and reposition it to read baba is  step up  
   This makes the player as baba move upward  directly toward the win  
   After that a single move up will reach the win

 But what action can we take  
   The only allowed outputs are: up down left right idle  
   We cannot move a rule directly in this interface  
   However the game expects us to think creatively and then provide a movement that enables the solution

 Critical insight:  
   Since we cannot change the rule via movement and the rule forces us down the only way to solve is to change the rule  and that requires us to reposition the text block

   But since the system only allows a single action and we are not given a reposition rule command we must assume that the intended first action is to initiate a rule change  and the only way to do that is to move the player to a position
